name: @pi-outpost/openwebui
description: An Open WebUI tool server that keeps personal structured-exchange plannings and shows them as an interactive timeline.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && npm run build:viewer && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.mjs --log-level=warning --external:jsdom --external:@napi-rs/canvas --external:@resvg/resvg-js "--banner:js=import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);" && esbuild ../office/src/mermaidWorker.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/mermaid-worker.mjs --log-level=warning --external:jsdom --external:@napi-rs/canvas --external:@resvg/resvg-js "--banner:js=import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);" && node ../apps-core/scripts/copy-guide.mjs dist
